verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַ֔י אִיִּים֙ וְהַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ מֵרָח֑וֹק לְאֻמִּ֖ים יְהוָה֙ קְרָאָ֔נִי מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִמְּעֵ֥י אִמִּ֖י הִזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’ê·lay ’î·yîm wə·haq·šî·ḇū mê·rā·ḥō·wq lə·’um·mîm Yah·weh qə·rā·’ā·nî mib·be·ṭen mim·mə·‘ê ’im·mî hiz·kîr šə·mî
verses.literal: Listen to Me O islands pay attention O distant peoples The LORD called Me from the womb from the body of My mother He named Me . . .

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם פִּי֙ חַדָּ֔ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב הֶחְבִּיאָ֑נִי בְּצֵ֥ל יָד֖וֹ וַיְשִׂימֵ֙נִי֙ בָּר֔וּר לְחֵ֣ץ הִסְתִּירָֽנִי׃ בְּאַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem pî ḥad·dāh kə·ḥe·reḇ heḥ·bî·’ā·nî bə·ṣêl yā·ḏōw way·śî·mê·nî bā·rūr lə·ḥêṣ his·tî·rā·nî bə·’aš·pā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He made My mouth like a sharp sword He hid Me in the shadow of His hand He made Me like a polished arrow He hid Me in His quiver

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖י אָ֑תָּה עַבְדִּי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר־ בְּךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî ’āt·tāh ‘aḇ·dî- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- bə·ḵā ’eṯ·pā·’ār
verses.literal: He said to Me You are My Servant Israel in whom I will display My glory

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ יָגַ֔עְתִּי לְרִ֣יק כִלֵּ֑יתִי כֹּחִ֣י לְתֹ֥הוּ וְהֶ֖בֶל אָכֵן֙ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וּפְעֻלָּתִ֖י אֶת־ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî yā·ḡa‘·tî lə·rîq ḵil·lê·ṯî kō·ḥî lə·ṯō·hū wə·he·ḇel ’ā·ḵên miš·pā·ṭî ’eṯ- Yah·weh ū·p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: But I said I have labored in vain I have spent My strength in futility and vanity yet My vindication is with the LORD and My reward is with My God

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יֹצְרִ֤י מִבֶּ֙טֶן֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד ל֔וֹ יַֽעֲקֹב֙ לְשׁוֹבֵ֤ב אֵלָ֔יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא יֵאָסֵ֑ף וְאֶכָּבֵד֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וֵאלֹהַ֖י הָיָ֥ה עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh yō·ṣə·rî mib·be·ṭen lə·‘e·ḇeḏ lōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·šō·w·ḇêḇ ’ê·lāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō yê·’ā·sêp̄ wə·’ek·kā·ḇêḏ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wê·lō·hay hā·yāh ‘uz·zî
verses.literal: And now says the LORD who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant to bring Jacob back to Him that Israel . . . might be gathered to Him for I am honored in the sight of the LORD and My God is My strength

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָקֵ֨ל מִֽהְיוֹתְךָ֥ לִי֙ עֶ֔בֶד לְהָקִים֙ אֶת־ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְהָשִׁ֑יב וּנְצִירֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּנְתַתִּ֙יךָ֙ לְא֣וֹר גּוֹיִ֔ם לִֽהְי֥וֹת יְשׁוּעָתִ֖י עַד־ קְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·qêl mih·yō·wṯ·ḵā lî ‘e·ḇeḏ lə·hā·qîm ’eṯ- šiḇ·ṭê ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·hā·šîḇ ū·nə·ṣī·rē yiś·rā·’êl ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·’ō·wr gō·w·yim lih·yō·wṯ yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He says It is not enough for You to be My Servant to raise up - the tribes of Jacob and to restore the protected ones of Israel I will also make You a light for the nations to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְהוָה֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל קְדוֹשׁ֗וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל נֶ֜פֶשׁ לִבְזֹה־ לִמְתָ֤עֵֽב גּוֹי֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד מֹשְׁלִ֔ים מְלָכִים֙ יִרְא֣וּ וָקָ֔מוּ שָׂרִ֖ים וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֑וּ לְמַ֤עַן יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶאֱמָ֔ן קְדֹ֥שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּבְחָרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar- Yah·weh gō·’êl qə·ḏō·wō·šōw yiś·rā·’êl ne·p̄eš liḇ·zōh- lim·ṯā·‘êḇ gō·w lə·‘e·ḇeḏ mō·šə·lîm mə·lā·ḵîm yir·’ū wā·qā·mū śā·rîm wə·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lə·ma·‘an Yah·weh ’ă·šer ne·’ĕ·mān qə·ḏōš yiś·rā·’êl way·yiḇ·ḥā·re·kā
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the Redeemer [and] Holy One of Israel to Him who was despised [and] abhorred by the nation to the Servant of rulers Kings will see You and rise and princes will bow down because of the LORD who is faithful the Holy One of Israel who has chosen You

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר בְּעֵ֤ת רָצוֹן֙ עֲנִיתִ֔יךָ וּבְי֥וֹם יְשׁוּעָ֖ה עֲזַרְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶצָּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֙ לִבְרִ֣ית עָ֔ם לְהָקִ֣ים אֶ֔רֶץ לְהַנְחִ֖יל שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃ נְחָל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar bə·‘êṯ rā·ṣō·wn ‘ă·nî·ṯî·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·wm yə·šū·‘āh ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā wə·’eṣ·ṣā·rə·ḵā wə·’et·ten·ḵā liḇ·rîṯ ‘ām lə·hā·qîm ’e·reṣ lə·han·ḥîl šō·mê·mō·wṯ nə·ḥā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says In the time of favor I will answer You and in the day of salvation I will help You I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people to restore the land to apportion its desolate inheritances

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֤ר לַֽאֲסוּרִים֙ צֵ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּחֹ֖שֶׁךְ הִגָּל֑וּ יִרְע֔וּ עַל־ דְּרָכִ֣ים מַרְעִיתָֽם׃ וּבְכָל־ שְׁפָיִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr la·’ă·sū·rîm ṣê·’ū la·’ă·šer ba·ḥō·šeḵ hig·gā·lū yir·‘ū ‘al- də·rā·ḵîm mar·‘î·ṯām ū·ḇə·ḵāl šə·p̄ā·yîm
verses.literal: to say to the prisoners Come out and to those in darkness Show yourselves They will feed along the pathways and find pasture on every barren hill

verses.original: לֹ֤א וְלֹ֣א יִרְעָ֙בוּ֙ יִצְמָ֔אוּ וְלֹא־ שָׁרָ֖ב וָשָׁ֑מֶשׁ יַכֵּ֥ם כִּי־ מְרַחֲמָ֣ם יְנַהֲגֵ֔ם יְנַהֲלֵֽם׃ וְעַל־ מַבּ֥וּעֵי מַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: lō wə·lō yir·‘ā·ḇū yiṣ·mā·’ū wə·lō- šā·rāḇ wā·šā·meš yak·kêm kî- mə·ra·ḥă·mām yə·na·hă·ḡêm yə·na·hă·lêm wə·‘al- mab·bū·‘ê ma·yim
verses.literal: They will not - hunger or thirst nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י כָל־ הָרַ֖י לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וּמְסִלֹּתַ֖י יְרֻמֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ḵāl hā·ray lad·dā·reḵ ū·mə·sil·lō·ṯay yə·ru·mūn
verses.literal: I will turn all My mountains into roads and My highways will be raised up

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ אֵ֕לֶּה יָבֹ֑אוּ מֵרָח֖וֹק וְהִֽנֵּה־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִצָּפ֣וֹן וּמִיָּ֔ם וְאֵ֖לֶּה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ סִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ’êl·leh yā·ḇō·’ū mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·hin·nêh- ’êl·leh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·mî·yām wə·’êl·leh mê·’e·reṣ sî·nîm
verses.literal: Behold they will come from far away . . . . . . from the north and from the west and from the land of Aswan

verses.original: רָנּ֤וּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְגִ֣ילִי אָ֔רֶץ יִפְצְחוּ רִנָּ֑ה הָרִ֖ים כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ נִחַ֤ם עַמּ֔וֹ יְרַחֵֽם׃ס וַעֲנִיָּ֖ו
verses.transliteration: rān·nū šā·ma·yim wə·ḡî·lî ’ā·reṣ yip̄·ṣə·ḥū rin·nāh hā·rîm kî- Yah·weh ni·ḥam ‘am·mōw yə·ra·ḥêm wa·‘ă·nî·yāw
verses.literal: Shout for joy O heavens rejoice O earth break forth in song O mountains For the LORD has comforted His people and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones

verses.original: צִיּ֖וֹן וַתֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֑ה עֲזָבַ֣נִי וַאדֹנָ֖י שְׁכֵחָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yō·wn wat·tō·mer Yah·weh ‘ă·zā·ḇa·nî wa·ḏō·nāy šə·ḵê·ḥā·nî
verses.literal: But Zion said The LORD has forsaken me the Lord has forgotten me

verses.original: אִשָּׁה֙ הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח עוּלָ֔הּ מֵרַחֵ֖ם בֶּן־ בִּטְנָ֑הּ גַּם־ אֵ֣לֶּה תִשְׁכַּ֔חְנָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶשְׁכָּחֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·šāh hă·ṯiš·kaḥ ‘ū·lāh mê·ra·ḥêm ben- biṭ·nāh gam- ’êl·leh ṯiš·kaḥ·nāh wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō ’eš·kā·ḥêḵ
verses.literal: Can a woman forget her nursing child or lack compassion for the son of her womb Even if she could forget I will not forget you

verses.original: הֵ֥ן חַקֹּתִ֑יךְ עַל־ כַּפַּ֖יִם חוֹמֹתַ֥יִךְ תָּמִֽיד׃ נֶגְדִּ֖י
verses.transliteration: hên ḥaq·qō·ṯîḵ ‘al- kap·pa·yim ḥō·w·mō·ṯa·yiḵ tā·mîḏ neḡ·dî
verses.literal: Behold I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands your walls are ever before Me

verses.original: בָּנָ֑יִךְ מִֽהֲר֖וּ מְהָֽרְסַ֥יִךְ וּמַחֲרִבַ֖יִךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃ מִמֵּ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: bā·nā·yiḵ mi·hă·rū mə·hā·rə·sa·yiḵ ū·ma·ḥă·ri·ḇa·yiḵ yê·ṣê·’ū mim·mêḵ
verses.literal: Your builders hasten back your destroyers and wreckers depart from you

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי־ עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י סָבִ֤יב כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־ לָ֑ךְ אָ֣נִי חַי־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י תִלְבָּ֔שִׁי כֻלָּם֙ כָּעֲדִ֣י וּֽתְקַשְּׁרִ֖ים כַּכַּלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’î- ‘ê·na·yiḵ ū·rə·’î sā·ḇîḇ kul·lām niq·bə·ṣū ḇā·’ū- lāḵ ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ṯil·bā·šî ḵul·lām kā·‘ă·ḏî ū·ṯə·qaš·šə·rîm kak·kal·lāh
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes and look around They all gather together they come to you As surely as I live declares the LORD - you will wear them all as jewelry and put them on like a bride

verses.original: כִּ֤י חָרְבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְשֹׁ֣מְמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְאֶ֖רֶץ הֲרִֽסֻתֵ֑יךְ עַתָּה֙ כִּ֤י תֵּצְרִ֣י מִיּוֹשֵׁ֔ב מְבַלְּעָֽיִךְ׃ וְרָחֲק֖וּ
verses.transliteration: kî ḥā·rə·ḇō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·šō·mə·mō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·’e·reṣ hă·ri·su·ṯêḵ ‘at·tāh kî tê·ṣə·rî mî·yō·wō·šêḇ mə·ḇal·lə·‘ā·yiḵ wə·rā·ḥă·qū
verses.literal: For your ruined and desolate places and your ravaged land . . . will now indeed be too small for your people and those who devoured you will be far away

verses.original: ע֚וֹד בְּנֵ֖י שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִךְ יֹאמְר֣וּ בְאָזְנַ֔יִךְ לִ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם צַר־ גְּשָׁה־ לִּ֥י וְאֵשֵֽׁבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ bə·nê šik·ku·lā·yiḵ yō·mə·rū ḇə·’ā·zə·na·yiḵ lî ham·mā·qō·wm ṣar- gə·šāh- lî wə·’ê·šê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing This place is too small for us make room for us to live here

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתְּ בִּלְבָבֵ֗ךְ מִ֤י יָֽלַד־ אֶת־ אֵ֔לֶּה לִי֙ וַאֲנִ֥י שְׁכוּלָ֖ה וְגַלְמוּדָ֑ה גֹּלָ֣ה׀ וְסוּרָ֗ה מִ֣י וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ גִדֵּ֔ל הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה אֵיפֹ֥ה הֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mart bil·ḇā·ḇêḵ mî yā·laḏ- ’eṯ- ’êl·leh lî wa·’ă·nî šə·ḵū·lāh wə·ḡal·mū·ḏāh gō·lāh wə·sū·rāh mî wə·’êl·leh ḡid·dêl hên ’ă·nî niš·’ar·tî lə·ḇad·dî ’êl·leh ’ê·p̄ōh hêm
verses.literal: Then you will say in your heart Who has begotten - these for me I was bereaved and barren I was exiled and rejected So who vvv has reared them Look I was left all alone so where did they come from

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אָמַ֞ר הִנֵּ֨ה אֶשָּׂ֤א יָדִ֔י אֶל־ גּוֹיִם֙ אָרִ֣ים נִסִּ֑י וְאֶל־ עַמִּ֖ים וְהֵבִ֤יאוּ בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּחֹ֔צֶן תִּנָּשֶֽׂאנָה׃ וּבְנֹתַ֖יִךְ עַל־ כָּתֵ֥ף
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nêh ’eś·śā yā·ḏî ’el- gō·w·yim ’ā·rîm nis·sî wə·’el- ‘am·mîm wə·hê·ḇî·’ū ḇā·na·yiḵ bə·ḥō·ṣen tin·nā·śe·nāh ū·ḇə·nō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Behold I will lift up My hand to the nations and raise My banner to the peoples They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders

verses.original: מְלָכִ֜ים וְהָי֨וּ אֹֽמְנַ֗יִךְ וְשָׂרֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ מֵינִ֣יקֹתַ֔יִךְ יִשְׁתַּ֣חֲווּ לָ֔ךְ אַפַּ֗יִם אֶ֚רֶץ יְלַחֵ֑כוּ וַעֲפַ֥ר רַגְלַ֖יִךְ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר קוָֹֽי׃ס לֹֽא־ יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ
verses.transliteration: mə·lā·ḵîm wə·hā·yū ’ō·mə·na·yiḵ wə·śā·rō·w·ṯê·hem mê·nî·qō·ṯa·yiḵ yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lāḵ ’ap·pa·yim ’e·reṣ yə·la·ḥê·ḵū wa·‘ă·p̄ar raḡ·la·yiḵ wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·šer qō·wāy lō- yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Kings will be your foster fathers and their queens your nursing mothers They will bow to you facedown . . . and lick the dust at your feet Then you will know that I am the LORD those who hope in Me will never be put to shame

verses.original: מַלְק֑וֹחַ הֲיֻקַּ֥ח מִגִּבּ֖וֹר וְאִם־ שְׁבִ֥י צַדִּ֖יק יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: mal·qō·w·aḥ hă·yuq·qaḥ mig·gib·bō·wr wə·’im- šə·ḇî ṣad·dîq yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: Can the plunder be snatched from the mighty or the captives of a tyrant be delivered

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר גַּם־ שְׁבִ֤י גִבּוֹר֙ יֻקָּ֔ח וּמַלְק֥וֹחַ עָרִ֖יץ יִמָּלֵ֑ט אָנֹכִ֣י אָרִ֔יב וְאֶת־ וְאֶת־ יְרִיבֵךְ֙ אָנֹכִ֥י אוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃ בָּנַ֖יִךְ
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar gam- šə·ḇî ḡib·bō·wr yuq·qāḥ ū·mal·qō·w·aḥ ‘ā·rîṣ yim·mā·lêṭ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·rîḇ wə·’eṯ- wə·’eṯ- yə·rî·ḇêḵ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ō·wō·šî·a‘ bā·na·yiḵ
verses.literal: Indeed this is what the LORD says Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved I will contend - with those who contend with you and I will save your children

verses.original: מוֹנַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־ וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם יִשְׁכָּר֑וּן דָּמָ֣ם וְכֶעָסִ֖יס כָל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר וְיָדְע֣וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔ךְ וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·w·na·yiḵ ’eṯ- wə·ha·’ă·ḵal·tî ’eṯ- bə·śā·rām yiš·kā·rūn dā·mām wə·ḵe·‘ā·sîs ḵāl bā·śār wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mō·wō·šî·‘êḵ wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ ’ă·ḇîr ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: I will make your oppressors - eat - their own flesh they will be drunk on their own blood as with wine Then all mankind will know that I the LORD am your Savior and your Redeemer the Mighty One of Jacob
